Repeat original strict OrthoBench F1 gain versus legacy with precision/recall decline at most0.005 and matched repaired-control/backend contrasts. inactivity: A reselect arm with zero completely measured queries follows the original fixed corrected-QfO then Three Kingdoms applicability order without retuning. Keep it labeled applicability_followup, not a pilot pass. Execution/tool/integrity failure is never inactivity. Projection-only repair is always applicable when its profiles were constructed; a failed original repair gate has no inactivity exception.
